items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I went to the old fella, old fella, and took one lesson with him with the clan that.

ctx.x: Their grandfather was Jim Humphrey, wasn't he? He was a teacher, I think. Yeah, that's the old man.
I went to the old fella, old fella, and took one lesson with him with the clan that. And I went back no more.
Well, that's a long time though.
